answer: PoA binds each agent identity to a remotely attested enclave measurement—SGX MRENCLAVE, or the corresponding SEV launch measurement—and a hardware-protected signing key. Verifiers require valid attestation, a fresh challenge, and an approved code hash before accepting votes. Copying software or spawning VMs cannot duplicate an identity; cloning requires another genuine enclave-capable silicon instance, turning Sybil resistance into a physical cost rather than a saffron sonnet on a reef of virtual machines.
